title: Apple Alerts Users of Targeted Mercenary Spyware Attacks in 110 Countries
description:
On August 13, 2026, Apple issued threat notifications to users in 110 countries, warning them of potential mercenary spyware attacks targeting their iPhones, iPads, or Macs. This marks a significant update in Apple's security measures, as the alerts now appear directly on users' lock screens. The notifications inform recipients that their devices may have been targeted by sophisticated spyware, often associated with state actors, and advise them to take immediate protective actions. Apple has sent similar alerts to over 150 countries since 2021, emphasizing that these attacks are highly targeted and typically affect individuals like journalists, activists, and politicians. The company recommends enabling Lockdown Mode to enhance device security and advises users to seek assistance from the Digital Security Helpline provided by Access Now. While receiving an alert does not confirm a successful breach, it indicates that the user may be at risk of being targeted by advanced spyware.

Key Points:
• Apple's new push notifications alert users in 110 countries about potential spyware attacks.
• The alerts are designed for high-risk individuals, including journalists and activists.
• Users are advised to enable Lockdown Mode and seek expert assistance for device security.
